15.9 Alarms and Monitoring Systems                                         
            15.9.1 Water Ingress Alarm System                                     
                 Effective means of monitoring water ingress into the pod interior space is to be provided at the
                 machinery control station(s).                                    
                                                                                  
            15.9.2 Shaft Bearing Monitoring                                       
                 Permanent means of continuous monitoring of shaft system vibration, or alternatively, a
                 continuous oil-debris monitoring system to detect the passage of metallic particles in the bearing
                 lubricating oil lines is to be provided at the machinery control station(s) in order to detect early
                 sign of pod shaft bearing deterioration. Where an oil-debris monitoring system is provided, a
                 detector of the system is to be fitted at the outlet of the bearing lubricating oil line before entering
                 the filters.
